label: HOST-ONLY DETERMINISTIC FIXTURE
purpose: Establish the effective temporal alignment of host_chroma12 -> chroma movement INDEPENDENTLY of BabySlakh. Determine whether the J3D-A -1 hop argmax is mechanically explained by frontend phase, or is an unexplained offset.

must_not: use any BabySlakh audio, MIDI or score
optimise any lag against a hypothesis metric
choose the answer after seeing it
hard_boundary.why: using the J3D-A result to justify a correction to the J3D-A result is circular. The timing rule must be fixed by an independent deterministic fixture before any reanalysis exists.

analytical_timing.hann_centre_s: (i-1)*0.032 - the Hann window is symmetric over n_fft, so its centroid is the window midpoint
analytical_timing.IMPORTANT_note: pitch_class_state in J3D-A uses the IDENTICAL window convention, so on window geometry ALONE both sides carry the same -1.5 hop phase and should cancel. Any residual offset must therefore come from what fills the window - Hann weighting of magnitude vs rectangular occupancy of note duration, the sqrt/clip nonlinearity in host_chroma12, or the L1 renormalisation - NOT from the nominal timestamp. The fixture measures the residual.

fixture.kind: deterministic additive synthesis. No Kontakt, no sampler, no corpus. The only timing effects present are the frontend's own.
state_pairs: C major triad -> F major triad

conditions.shape: state A sustained 4 s, then state B sustained 4 s
A 3 s, B 3 s, A 3 s
as AB, with both states normalised to identical RMS so amplitude carries no timing information

transition.primary: 4 ms raised-cosine equal-power crossfade - far shorter than the 128 ms analysis window, so it cannot dominate the measured group delay, but long enough to remove the broadband click of a hard switch
transition.control: hard switch with no crossfade, reported alongside. If the two disagree the crossfade is driving the measurement and the run is INCONCLUSIVE.

fixture.synthesis: each note is 6 harmonics at 1/k amplitude, phase-continuous within a state; transition times are exact by construction
fixture.status: TIMING FIXTURE ONLY. It is not musical evidence and makes no claim about harmony, perception or value.

measurement.audio_side: run host_chroma12 on the fixture, L1-normalise rows, form the SAME movement measure as J3D-A: 0.5*L1(chroma_t, chroma_{t-8})
measurement.symbolic_side: run pitch_class_state on the fixture's exact note list with the SAME window convention, then the SAME movement measure
statistics_per_pair_and_condition: peak frame of the audio movement response
peak frame of the symbolic movement response
response centre of each (centroid of the response mass in a window around the transition)
50% rise point of the underlying chroma state distance, as a second independent group-delay estimate
measurement.aggregate: median and interquartile spread of the offset across all pairs x conditions

outcome_thresholds.CHROMA_PHASE_EXPLAINED: median offset in [-1.5, -0.5] hops AND interquartile spread <= 1.0 hop AND every condition's median offset is negative. This is compatible with the J3D-A -1 hop argmax.
outcome_thresholds.CHROMA_PHASE_NOT_EXPLAINED: median offset >= -0.25 hops (essentially zero or positive), OR the crossfade and hard-switch controls disagree by more than 1 hop
outcome_thresholds.CHROMA_PHASE_INCONCLUSIVE: anything else - including multi-modal responses or spread > 1 hop

what_each_outcome_permits.EXPLAINED: J3D-C2 mechanistic reanalysis may run, applying ONLY this independently measured correction. No lag search. No BabySlakh-derived offset.
what_each_outcome_permits.NOT_EXPLAINED: STOP. Do not run J3D-C2 and do not run J3D-B. Investigate the construct or the alignment further.

what_this_can_never_establish: that harmonic movement has visual value
any change to the J3D-A v1 or v2 receipts
